annotations.title: Find HRSA funding opportunities for health centers

description: Search the funding opportunities HRSA (the federal agency that funds health centers) lists on Grants.gov, both forecasts and posted notices. Filter by words in the title, number or description, to the Health Center Program's own opportunities, by status, or to those open for applications on a day. Returns short rows with the application due date as published (and whether it is HRSA's estimate), amounts as published, the Grants.gov page and the ClinX page, soonest due date first. Give opportunity (a number such as HRSA-27-006) for one in full, with its description, who can apply and every date.

health_center_program.description: True for only the opportunities HRSA files under the Health Center Program itself.

open_on.description: Only notices posted on or before this day whose applications are due on or after it, year-month-day. A forecast is not open.

opportunity.description: One opportunity in full, by its number (for example HRSA-27-006) or its Grants.gov id (for example 363419).

status.description: forecasted: HRSA plans to publish it, dates are estimates. posted: the notice is published.

text.description: Words to look for in the title, the opportunity number and the description.
